exclusion_reason: The compatibility-ratings surface is implemented: a rating shows only when it is backed by a replay record that reproduces its recorded session and its revision is current; a superseded revision greys out and an unbacked or non-reproducing rating is hidden. The benchmark stays red because producing the live replay session that backs a rating needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the surface shows only record-backed rating and the stale case greys out.
active_gate_evidence: test/library.test.mjs asserts a reproduced current rating shows, a reproduced stale-revision rating greys out, and non-reproduced and record-less ratings are hidden.
procedure: Replay the record and verify reproduction.
Expire a revision and assert the rating greys out.
